title: Customs House, Brisbane

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the Queen Street approach beside the main building.

mapIdentity.scope: The native twenty-point OSM outline locates the twin orthogonal wings, narrower central bay and curved northeast projection. The floor count and copper dome are corroborated by the current operator.

note: Work from the Queen Street approach datum. There are two street-side floors and an exposed basement on the river side about 3.4 metres below it. The ribbed hemispherical roof reaches roughly the mapped 20 m height at the lantern.
